answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

一张满页幻灯片式版面:眉标 `TOP IDEAS`、大标题 `Overweight European High Yield Credit`、蓝色导语段,然后是无编号图表——粗体图题 `European HY Credit Offers the Highest Yield on USD-Hedged Basis` 加斜体副题 `Yield decomposition across major credit asset classes`。图本身是 5 类堆积柱,三个系列(Base Rate / Option-Adjusted Spread (OAS) / EURUSD 3m Hedging Income),图例横排在类别轴下方。关键在于:堆积段数不齐——`EM Hard Currency`、`USD High Yield`、`USD IG Corp` 只有两段,没有浅蓝对冲收益段;且柱顶只印合计 `8.1%`、`5.6%`,段内一个数字都不印。左轴 `0%`–`9%`,每 1% 一格,无网格线。

**定位一个值难在哪**

以 `3.3%` 为例:它是 `EUR High Yield` 的 OAS 段,页面上没有这个数,必须读出该段下沿约 2.5% 与上沿约 5.8% 再相减。5% 容差只有 0.17 个百分点,而刻度间距是 1%,两个边界各自的读数误差就会吃掉容差。`2.3%` 更麻烦:`EUR High Yield` 与 `EUR IG Corp` 的浅蓝段高度相同,同一个数对应两个 mark。

**不确定的**

没有图号,也没有独立的单位短语——单位只藏在轴刻度的百分号里。`2.3%` 究竟指哪一根柱无法判定;`4.4%` 与 `4.5%` 谁属 `USD High Yield`、谁属 `USD IG Corp`,只能靠像素高度猜。

heading.title: European HY Credit Offers the Highest Yield on USD-Hedged Basis
heading.subtitle: Yield decomposition across major credit asset classes

worked_example.why_hard: Interior segment: only the 8.1% stack total is printed; value needs subtracting two boundaries on 1% ticks

components.evidence: each bar stacks Base Rate, OAS and hedging income; bar top equals the printed total
legend row sits under the category tick labels: 'Base Rate', 'Option-Adjusted Spread (OAS)', 'EURUSD 3m Hedging Income'
'Source: Bloomberg, MSIM. As of May 22, 2025. For illustrative purposes only.' below the plot
'8.1%', '7.9%', '7.6%', '5.6%', '5.4%' printed in bold above each bar top
blue intro paragraph above the chart: 'The reduction in global growth risks from the recent positive trade negotiation outcomes...'

new_components.name: stack_total_label_only
new_components.evidence: only the stack total ('8.1%') is printed; none of the three segments carries a number

new_components.name: series_absent_in_some_stacks
new_components.evidence: 'EM Hard Currency', 'USD High Yield', 'USD IG Corp' bars have no light-blue hedging segment at all

new_components.name: duplicate_segment_heights_across_bars
new_components.evidence: the hedging segment looks identical in height on 'EUR High Yield' and 'EUR IG Corp'

spot_checks.mark: the EUR High Yield Base Rate segment (bottom dark blue)
the EUR High Yield Option-Adjusted Spread segment (grey, ~2.5% to ~5.8%)
the USD High Yield Base Rate segment (bottom dark blue)
the EUR IG Corp hedging segment (light blue top); the EUR High Yield hedging segment looks the same height
the USD IG Corp Base Rate segment (bottom dark blue)

answer.hardest_step_why: 段值均未印,如 3.3% 须由 2.5% 与 5.8% 两边界相减;刻度间距 1%,5% 容差仅 0.17pp。

examples.quote: '8.1%' in bold above the EUR High Yield bar top; no number printed inside any of its three segments
examples.why: 当前只会全印或全不印;此页只在堆积柱顶印合计,段内留空。

examples.quote: y axis ticks read 0%,1%,...,9%; the grey OAS segment runs from about 2.5% to about 5.8%
examples.why: 内部段的可达精度取决于两条边界的读数,不是一个整体可读/不可读的开关。

examples.quote: Bold 'European HY Credit Offers the Highest Yield on USD-Hedged Basis' over italic 'Yield decomposition across major credit asset classes'; no figure number
examples.why: 标题需拆为粗体主题+斜体副题且无编号,单位只存在于轴刻度的百分号。

examples.quote: EM Hard Currency, USD High Yield and USD IG Corp bars show only two segments; the light-blue hedging band is absent
examples.why: 需支持某系列在部分类别上整段缺席(非零值、非N/A),生成器目前按满矩阵出图。
